theorems.name: Submission.sobolev_of_level_integral_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (C J : ℝ), 2 ≤ n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → (∀ x, 0 ≤ h x) → 0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ J → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → ((n : ℝ) - 1) / n * ∫ x in {x | ε < h x}, (h x ^ ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1)) - ε ^ ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1))) ∂μ ≤ C * (∫ x in {x | 0 < h x}, (h x + ε) ^ ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1)) ∂μ) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * J) → (∫ x, h x ^ ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1)) ∂μ) ^ (((n : ℝ) - 1) / n) ≤ (n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1) * C * J
